text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, didn't I need some 
new body cream?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...This one, then. I'll have to ask Nanny 
tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... There really are so many more 
varieties now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should try a new fragrance. 
Should it be this one, or this one... or 
maybe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu ended up staying up late 
researching beauty products...
